NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️ | Screenshots: two images were added in a comment, but the description still says "Screenshots to be added by author in comments", and none clearly show "before". The issue asks for before/after at different sizes. |
| ✅ | Testing notes: the description says how it was tested (dev server, width under 500px). |
| ✅ | Description and "Fixes #40051": both are present, and the issue has "help wanted". |
| ⚠️ | Self-review checklist: it is filled in, but "Strings and tooltips" and "Corner cases, error conditions, and easily imagined bugs" are unchecked, and the author gave no note on them. |
| ℹ️ | There was no new push, so the commit is unchanged. CI is passing. |
| ℹ️ | Competing PR #40052 (PrachiiiiisHere) touches the same file for the same issue. That author was unassigned from the issue on 2026-09-13, but #40052 is still open. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the description and screenshots. Decide separately what to do with #40052.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the screenshots! Could you put before/after screenshots at a few different widths in the PR description, and replace the "Screenshots to be added" placeholder? Please also finish the self-review checklist, or note why the unchecked items don't apply. The [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) and [presenting visual changes](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html) cover this.
```
